teacher_info.introduction:
My name is Dr. Rod Rogers. 

I am from the United States, but currently live and work in Guadalajara, Mexico. 

FOCUS 
I help you achieve your English learning goals as quickly and enjoyably as possible. I minimize the use of complex grammar lessons and focus on fun, understandable conversation without anxiety. I follow Stephen Krashen's "Comprehensible Input Theory of language learning"--"Language acquisition does not require extensive use of conscious grammatical rules, and does not require tedious drill....The best methods are therefore those that supply 'comprehensible input' in low anxiety situations, containing messages that students really want to hear." 

QUALIFICATIONS 
TEFL certifications in both General and Business English. I have been a life-long learner of languages. I have studied Portuguese, mastered biblical Greek and Hebrew, and currently am learning to speak Spanish. I have presented thousands of lessons and speeches all around the world. I have Bachelor's, Master's, and Doctor's degrees in Bible, Old Testament and Semitic Languages, and Communications. I am the published author of three books and one short fiction story. 


WHAT MAKES ME A SPECIAL TEACHER IS... 
* my sense of humor--we will always have fun! 
* my genuine concern to help you learn 
* my in-depth knowledge of the English language gained in earning two advanced degrees 
* my experience in writing and publishing several books 
* my 35 years of teaching experience in schools, in churches, and as a professional speaker 
* my understanding of how to learn a language

CLASS PROCEDURE
I have many back to back classes. So, in order to start each class on time, my policy is to provide a brief summary of our lesson 5 minutes before the class ends, and to close our connection 2 minutes early. This gives each student the maximum time possible.

pro_course_detail.title: Pronunciation Class with homework
pro_course_detail.description:
This class is for all levels. It is never too early or too late to work on your pronunciation!

I have extensive experience with Spanish, Chinese, and Russian speakers. 
I have identified the main issues that these students have, and know how to fix them. We will target these sounds first, so that you can finally pronounce all of the sounds in English correctly. 

After we correct the pronunciation of sounds, we can move on to more complex issues such as connected speech and linking, so that you can sound confident and natural :) 

Your success will be determined by how much you PRACTICE! A teacher can show you how to pronounce sounds, but if you don't practice it, you won't change the way you speak.  You use dozens of different muscles in your body when you speak (you use your nose, face, throat and stomach too!) Muscles have to be exercised if you want results. 

Materials for this class:
- A Google document with homework and notes, and links to videos 
- A pronunciation book as a pdf

pro_course_detail.title: Intermediate or Advanced speaking practice through conversation
pro_course_detail.description:
(This is not a grammar class. If you want to focus on grammar, please choose that option :)
If you want homework assignments, writing practice/editing, or a study plan, please choose the grammar class.)

The point of this class to FOR YOU TO TALK!  If you cannot give long responses, I will teach you how :)

I want you to speak as much as possible, and I will patiently listen.  You can choose the topic at the beginning of the class, or we will naturally choose one together. This natural, unplanned kind of practice gives you practice thinking and speaking under a little bit of pressure, LIKE IN REAL LIFE. I plan topics in advance for my beginner students, but I think speaking spontaneously is more beneficial for intermediate  / advanced students. 

I will correct your grammar and pronunciation along the way. You will feel like you are talking with a friend, except this friend can help you with your English and answer any questions you may have. You will practice listening, learn new vocabulary and grammatical structures in the most natural way possible - conversation.

It it HIGHLY recommended to either take notes during the class, or to go back and paste our Skype notes into a Google doc or some other place. You need to review the corrections and practice them.

pro_course_detail.title: Beginners- start speaking :)

This option is for beginners who *know some basic things* (so not absolute beginners,) but don't have confidence to speak. 

If your native language is Spanish, I will be able to speak to you, translate, and help you in Spanish if you need it. If your native language is Portuguese, I will be able to understand and translate most things into English...and give you answers in Spanish, which you will probably understand. 

Its best for you to be in control of your learning. We should talk about what YOU like. So if you can tell me a topic you want to practice, you will have a more useful class. 

One of my strengths as a teacher is making students, no matter how nervous, feel comfortable. I will patiently guide you through a conversation.  We will be relaxed, and you will finish the class with new vocabulary words and phrases.  I will write new words for you in the chat, and you should copy these down later either into a Google document or into a notebook. Learning is active, not passive. You should take notes after the class. But during the class, you can just focus on speaking.

pro_course_detail.title: Grammar with homework  (all levels)
pro_course_detail.description:
The problem with grammar classes in big institutes or schools is usually that you don't have the chance to practice what you have learned. In a private 1:1 class, that's half of what we do :)

I use a combination of infographics, pictures, videos, websites, books, podcasts, and even songs to help you REALLY, finally understand grammar.  

We will start by introducing the topic. I will tell you when and how we use it. We will do some examples. And then we'll start using it. 

Homework is an important part in making progress and REMEMBERING what you've learned. For grammar classes I give grammar exercises, but also videos, podcasts, or songs. We check the homework at the beginning of the next class. 

You won't need to take grammar classes forever! Once you've learned a few new concepts, I recommend taking some conversation classes to practice it in a real world like environment.

pro_course_detail.title: LISTENING- how to understand native speakers!
pro_course_detail.description:
I have really good news for you. You are not bad at listening, and native speakers don't speak ~fast.

There are patterns in our speech that you were never taught. *English does not sound the way it is writtten.* Spoken English is different from written English. 

I am sure that you are going to be surprised when I teach you how we really speak (for example, when you realize that  ' what did you' sounds like 'wuh jew.' )

You can definitely learn these patterns and decode native English with practice. 

I will teach you the rules and patterns of spoken US English so you can finally understand it. I will also introduce / explain some common dialects and accents within the United States (southern, black, Indian English, etc.) I can adjust my speech to sound as slow, or as natural / native as possible, so that I can give you explanations in a very clear way.

Materials for this class include a book that I will send you, a Google document where we will keep your homework, and Youtube videos. 

As with all of my classes, we can use Spanish at any time that you need or want to. :)

* SKYPE or Italki * - This is  a beginner and  intermediate level course  for ages 6.5 year olds and older. Ideally, you already know phonics and can read short sentences. Your  goal is to build a strong  foundation for easily  understanding and speaking on everyday topics for functioning in English-speaking cultures.

Conversations may include food, travel, school, hobbies, chores, dreams,  technology, trends, entertainment, health, traditions, shopping, pop culture, and more.

Through this class students get close 1 on 1 attention. 

Learners will:
-Read progressive picture stories both fiction and non-fiction (Biff & Chip, Raz Kids, Epic, news)
- Answer and form questions with Who What When Where Why How Do Does and To Be
- Identify fundamental parts of speech such as verbs, nouns, adjectives and adverbs
- Quickly build vocabulary and expressions 
- Understand grammar rules that are explained step by step
- Play fun learning games
- Master the 44 sounds of English for clear pronunciation
- Learn the 12 past, present, and future tenses. 
- Express experiences and opinions
- Compare and contrast
- Summarize short videos
- Recognize spelling patterns
- Write well-written informative essays and creative stories
- Give show-and-tell presentations
- Take quizzes
- Do optional homework. 

If your goal is to  consistently improve your English,  make sure to schedule lessons regularly.

Engagement and frequency are the secrets to mastering English, and I will be there to help you along.

 The 2 basic requirements for signing up for classes are 1. A good attitude and 2. Trying.

pro_course_detail.title: Beginner English: Everyday English Essentials
pro_course_detail.description:
Welcome to Beginner English for Adults, a friendly and interactive class where you'll dive into the basics of English that are actually useful in your daily life! This class is designed for true beginners, so don't worry if you're starting from scratch. Together, we'll focus on the essential words and phrases you need to make small talk, ask questions, order food, get directions, and more.

Each session includes:

Real-Life Conversations: Practice English you'll use in shops, cafes, public transport, and social settings.

Fun Activities: Games, group work, and role-playing to make learning lively and memorable.

Listening & Speaking Practice: Gain confidence with speaking and understanding common phrases and native speakers’ accents.

Friendly Support: Learn in a relaxed, no-judgment environment where everyone’s learning at their own pace.

Whether you want to travel, connect with friends, or just feel more comfortable in English-speaking environments, this class will help you get there one step at a time. Come ready to talk, laugh, and learn!

We'll discuss topics such as: Holidays, Food, Clothes, Shopping, Sports, Jobs, Daily Routine, Animals, Hobbies, etc

pro_course_detail.title: Understanding American Idioms & Phrasal Verbs
pro_course_detail.description:
This course focuses on mastering common idioms and phrasal verbs—essential tools for navigating everyday conversations and enhancing your understanding of American English.

What You Will Learn:

***Common Idioms: Explore the meanings and usage of popular idioms that native speakers use in casual conversation. Discover how these phrases add color and depth to communication.

***Phrasal Verbs: Gain proficiency in phrasal verbs—verb phrases that change meaning when combined with prepositions or adverbs. Learn how they are used in everyday speech and writing.

***Contextual Understanding: Learn how idioms and phrasal verbs fit into various contexts, helping you understand conversations, movies, and media more effectively.

***Practical Application: Engage in interactive exercises, role-playing scenarios, and group discussions to practice using idioms and phrasal verbs in real-life situations.
